description: The exploration angles Mynt hands out, one per explorer, in this order. Each explorer gets one and stays on it.

angles.title: Tighten or add knockouts
angles.brief: Find where defaults concentrate in the dev set and decline those applicants up front with clear knockout rules and reason codes, without declining good applicants wholesale.

angles.title: Re-cut grades and limits
angles.brief: Re-draw the risk grades and the limit assigned to each grade (for example against income and existing obligations), so approved amounts match what applicants can repay.

angles.title: Re-price by risk
angles.brief: Set the APR by risk grade so riskier approvals pay for their expected loss, staying within the APR cap in the job.

angles.title: Approve more good applicants
angles.brief: Look for applicants the current algorithm declines who repay in the dev set, and approve them where the loss ceiling and fairness threshold still hold.

angles.title: Recalibrate the score
angles.brief: Refit the weights or cut-offs of the algorithm's score on the dev set's features, keeping it simple enough to explain with reason codes.
